name: Thai Red Turkey Meatball Curry
method: Mix the turkey mince, sliced spring onions, garlic, breadcrumbs and egg in a bowl, then shape into 12 small balls.
Heat the oil in a large deep pan over a medium heat and fry the meatballs for 6 to 8 minutes until golden all over. Lift out onto a plate.
Boil the rice for 10 to 12 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes, then drain.

Fry the curry paste in the same pan for 2 minutes, then pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer. Return the meatballs and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until cooked through with no pink inside. Season with fish sauce and a squeeze of lime.
Divide the rice and beans between bowls, spoon over the curry and scatter with torn basil, coriander and sesame seeds, with lime wedges alongside.
